parameters.help_en: The domain name. The value must be 1 to 50 characters in length and can contain digits, uppercase letters, lowercase letters, periods (.), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 域名，长度1-50，可以包含数字、大写字母、小写字母、.、-
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The selector field in the DomainKeys Identified Mail (DKIM) protocol, which is used to identify a specific public key.
Leave this parameter empty. The system automatically generates a value based on the cluster information.
If you manually specify a value, for example, if the sending domain name is sub.example.com and the dkimSelector is set to default, the host record is default._domainkey.sub.

Constraints:
The value can be up to 60 characters in length.
The value must consist of visible characters.
The value cannot start with a hyphen (-).
The value cannot end with a hyphen (-).
The value cannot contain the following characters: _ :;/!*~.@#$%^&()+=[{]}|?<>,"'\
parameters.help_zh:
DKIM协议中的selector字段，用于标识特定公钥的字段。
建议为空，系统会根据集群信息自动生成。
如果用户手工指定，比如发信域名是sub.example.com，dkimSelector填写的是default，那么主机记录就是default._domainkey.sub

约束：
长度不能大于60
必须是可见字符
不能以-打头
不能以-结尾
不能包含以下字符_ :;/!*~.@#$%^&()+=[{]}|?<>,"'\
parameters.name: dkim_selector
